segments.ssml: <prosody rate='92%'>The evening air is warm and sweet <break time='300ms'/> with the scent of roasted lamb and fresh bread.</prosody> <break time='500ms'/> <s>Music drifts across the courtyard of a modest but proud home <break time='200ms'/> in Cana of Galilee.</s>

You are <prosody rate='92%' volume='+2dB'>Matthias</prosody>, the master of the feast <break time='300ms'/> — a man of reputation, hired to ensure this wedding celebration is <prosody rate='85%' volume='+4dB'>flawless</prosody>.
<prosody rate='85%'>A servant places a cup before you. <break time='400ms'/> You drink. <break time='600ms'/> And the world <prosody rate='85%' volume='+4dB'>stops</prosody>.</prosody>

<prosody rate='90%'>This wine <break time='300ms'/> — it is <prosody rate='85%' volume='+4dB'>extraordinary</prosody>. <break time='200ms'/> Rich, deep, layered with a complexity that the finest vineyards in Jerusalem could not produce.</prosody>
<prosody rate='88%'>Something is impossible. <break time='500ms'/> And yet <break time='300ms'/> — it is <prosody rate='85%' volume='+4dB'>undeniably</prosody> real.</prosody>

<prosody rate='95%'>Everyone serves the good wine first, and the cheaper wine after the guests have drunk freely.</prosody> <break time='400ms'/> <prosody rate='90%' volume='+2dB'>But <prosody rate='85%' volume='+4dB'>you</prosody> — you have kept the good wine until <prosody rate='85%' volume='+4dB'>now</prosody>!</prosody>
<prosody rate='92%'>The bridegroom smiles <break time='200ms'/> — but you see the flicker of confusion in his eyes. <break time='400ms'/> He doesn't know where this wine came from either.</prosody>
<prosody rate='85%' volume='loud'>I intend to find out <break time='300ms'/> what happened.</prosody>
<prosody rate='90%'>The hour grows late. <break time='300ms'/> Guests are beginning to leave. <break time='400ms'/> The courtyard thins.</prosody>

<prosody rate='95%' volume='+2dB'>I'm running out of time. <break time='300ms'/> The witnesses will scatter by dawn. <break time='200ms'/> I <prosody rate='85%' volume='+4dB'>must</prosody> piece this together now.</prosody>
<prosody rate='88%'>You sit alone at the head table <break time='400ms'/> — your cup still half full of the wine that should not exist.</prosody>
<prosody rate='85%'>I have eliminated every explanation I know. <break time='600ms'/> What remains <break time='300ms'/> is the one I don't.</prosody>

<prosody rate='90%'><prosody rate='92%' volume='+2dB'>Water became wine.</prosody> <break time='400ms'/> The servants saw it. <break time='300ms'/> The mother believed it. <break time='300ms'/> The fishermen call it <prosody rate='85%' volume='+4dB'>the first sign</prosody>.</prosody>

<prosody rate='85%'>I don't have an answer. <break time='500ms'/> But for the first time in my careful, controlled life <break time='400ms'/> — the mystery itself <break time='300ms'/> is <prosody rate='85%' volume='+4dB'>enough</prosody>. <break time='600ms'/> What I witnessed tonight was not a trick. <break time='300ms'/> It was a sign. And signs point to something greater.</prosody>
<prosody rate='88%'>You step out into the cool Galilean night. <break time='500ms'/> The stars are <prosody rate='92%' volume='+2dB'>impossibly</prosody> bright.</prosody>
